title: Protects the Chair!
text: Protects the Chair!. This does a good job of protecting the chair. It fits our Lazy-Boy recliner well. I'm not crazy about all the ties it has. We have a similar cover for a winged back chair we have and it had elastic straps which were easier to use to attach it to the chair. We have cats who often leave hairballs on our furniture, so we're glad to have this.

product_metadata.title: DEARTOWN Recliner Chair Cover Oversized Waterproof Anti-Slip Large Recliner Slipcover for Home Pet Dog Machine Washable
features: 100% Waterproof - Our recliner chair covers have enhanced our processes to manufacture 100% waterproof materials. Even after washing it remains user friendly
No More Stain - It will save your furniture from Puppy slobber and bite marks, kids mischief and spills.
Non-slip - There are 19 strings to help avoid sliding, even when using leather furniture. No more straps or foam, allow for a more elegant appearance that is also environmental friendly
Handy Pockets - Two bigger side pockets and three smaller side pockets are located on each armrest. They are designed to hold books, glasses, cellphone, or remote controls, magazines
Good Material - Pet fur doesn’t cling to the cover. It can also easily remove pet hairs from the cover and is conveniently machine washable, can be tumble dried
